Indianapolis Motor Speedway (road course) — survey

USA · United States GP (retired, 2000–07 layout) · theme modern, day-only (night:false) · branch cursor/indianapolis-survey-a1 · base c2e302b (deploy tip + merges of shared-shot-tooling-5b45 and day-wet-lighting-b7b8, both clean) · captured 2026-10-15 · TLX renderer on SwiftShader, 1280×720, 74 frames. Read-only survey: no js/css edits.

Legend: measured from the built centreline or audit tools · source claim read in code or brief · seen in a rendered frame. Anything marked "uncertain" is a guess.

1. Summary

Geometry is clean: verify-track passes, every audit check is within baseline, and the built lap closes. The weak spots are visual. There is no authored lighting at dusk or night, the stand wall is a string of separate boxes rather than the continuous wall the brief demands, the infield is nearly empty, and overcast, fog and storm barely change the sky. See §8 for the ranked list.

6. Code and scenery deep-dive

  • Side convention. The scenery header (:28-43) records that the infield is side +1 and the outside is −1; the code uses rot() to keep geometry handedness on the far side. Every landmark is authored once and rotated, so a side flip would break the digits and pit stalls. I found no side errors in the frames.
  • Stand bank spacing. BAY_LEN = 38 while the loop pitch is 40/4073 of the lap (≈40 m): each bay leaves a ≈2 m gap and carries endWalls:true. That is what the aerial and f83 frames show: separate boxes with daylight between. At the corner (arc ≈0.85–0.91) the 3 m radius bunching changes the apparent gap.
  • Banking bound to the wrong comments. The scenery and brief still say "oval Turn 1 at 0.115" in places (e.g. §4 of the brief). The def moved the bank to 0.880 (def :66-74), so the spectatorHill(0.085, 0.145, IN) comment (:415-416) that calls it the "banked oval Turn 1 sector" is stale: it actually lines the F1 T1 run-in.
  • Frac-zone mismatch in widths. hwZones are control-index fractions. The 6.4 m zone 0.240–0.700 builds at arc 0.259–0.635, and the gap before the next zone is built as 8.0 m between 0.642 and 0.658 (a 16 m-wide road in the middle of the infield, next to T13 at 0.639). The brief wants 6.4 m throughout 0.24–0.70.
  • Foliage rules. The foliage exclusion starts at 0.86, but the oval runs from 0.741 (road widens back to 8 m). Trees appear inside the oval at arc 0.76–0.85 (visible in the f83 frames), although the brief says "nothing grows inside the oval". Meanwhile the explicit tree() loop (:350-359) is limited to 0.28–0.72, which is why the infield looks sparse.
  • Ridges. The ridge() ring at 11–19 m high is the main horizon feature (:386-399). The brief says "no hills at all... a low treeline"; the ring reads as dark green slabs with straight edges, a hard line against the sky at ground level.
  • Lighting. night:false (def :30) and floodMast(..., { light:false, pool:false }) (:413) mean no lit stands, no pools. The sim still lets a player pick dusk or night, where only the generic lamp posts (furniture) light the road.
  • Real-world cross-check (docs/tracks/indianapolis.md research pass): 13 turns, clockwise, ≈4.192 km, Pagoda, Yard of Bricks, scoring pylon, Paddock/Tower Terrace opposite the Pagoda are all present. Estimates, not measured: Pagoda height (sources disagree: 10 storeys, 199 ft, 160 ft), bay capacities, and the number of garage sheds. URLs in §9.
  • Brief inconsistencies. §3 says 9° banking, §5 says 6° at 0.88; §4 puts banking at 0.115; §1 says 15 m road width but baseHW 8 gives 16 m. These are doc drifts, not render bugs.

8. Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

  1. No authored dusk or night lighting seen · js/circuits/scenery/indianapolis.js:413 (light:false, pool:false), js/circuits/indianapolis.js:30 (night:false). At dusk and night the oval stand bank, Pagoda side, pit stalls and masts are flat dark shapes; only generic lamp posts glow, and dusk f17 has a heavy orange wash. Fix: either gate the TOD picker for day-only circuits, or turn on mast light/pool on a dusk/night path (as on the seven night circuits).
  2. Stand wall is not continuous seen · scenery :49-62. 38 m bays on a 40 m pitch with endWalls:true make separate boxes with gaps (aerial f00, orbit f83). Brief §6 requires one wall. Fix: bay length = pitch, endWalls only at the segment ends.
  3. Overcast and fog skies stay saturated blue seen · engine, js/lighting/atmosphere.js (post PR #1979) plus def pal.zenith :46-55. Day-overcast and day-fog frames keep a deep blue band at the top. Even day-dry has a hard blue zenith and a sharp horizon line, versus the brief's hazy horizon. Mechanism uncertain: a weather blend that leaves the zenith untouched. For the parent to confirm with __apex.lightState.
  4. Infield is nearly empty seen · scenery :350-359 (trees only 0.28–0.72, ~45% pass) with def foliage exclusion :37-38; wide tan apron band beside the road (cause uncertain, probably terrain skirt/apron colour). Aerial f00/f50 shows large bare grass plates, brief §6 concedes "low, open, grassy" so partly intended, but the ground reads as one flat plane.
  5. Ridge ring reads as hard-edged slabs seen · scenery :386-399. Brief says "no hills"; slabs 11–19 m high give a dark straight-edged band at the horizon (orbit f50) and are visible from the aerial. Fix: lower hMin, add noise/length variation, or drop to the low treeline the brief describes.
  6. Town of Speedway reads as stray crates seen · :520-529. 14–22 m blocks every 70 m, ≈ 130 m back, tiny against the oval and isolated in empty green (aerial). Fix: cluster into street blocks or thin to the horizon.
  7. Trees inside the oval at 0.76–0.85 and wet-grass mirror seen · def :37 (exclusion begins at 0.86, the oval starts ≈0.74). In day-rain/wet f83 the clump casts barred mirror reflections on the grass. Fix: widen the exclusion to 0.74→0.22; the reflection is an engine wet-ground effect (uncertain).
  8. Infield road widens to 16 m mid-lap measured · def :61-64. Arc 0.642–0.658 is 8.0 m half-width between two 6.4–6.6 m sections. Fix: extend the first zone's s1 (about 0.70→0.76 control-index) so it ends where the oval begins.
  9. Rain and storm are darker than overcast and near-identical to each other seen. Day-rain looks like dusk. Storm differs from rain only by streak density. Engine, atmosphere (verify after PR #1979 merges to deploy).
  10. Doc drift source · docs/tracks/indianapolis.md §1/§3/§4/§5 (bank location and angle, road width); stale comment at scenery :415-416.

9. Not captured / uncertain

  • No chase (park), cockpit or cinematic views; no HUD. No GLX or WGX backend: TLX only, on SwiftShader (no real GPU, so exposure and bloom are not what a player's GPU shows).
  • Trackside f00 frame is black: the camera landed inside the stand/pit structure. Treat it as a capture artefact. It was not re-shot.
  • Only 6 lap positions; the pit lane interior, Gasoline Alley, the museum and the oval short chute (0.74–0.82) were never framed close up. Pit stall and Pagoda detail are therefore unverified.
  • Night with storm, dusk with fog, dawn and the overcast/fog/wet variants at dusk and night were not captured, to stay inside the capture budget.
  • Gallery naming deviates slightly from the task text: files are indianapolis-NN-view-fNN-<tod>-<weather>.png, because build-gallery.cjs parses time-of-day before weather.
  • Gallery build: build-gallery.cjs --out=scratch/gallery-out --no-fetch --skip-images exits 0 and lists 74 Indianapolis frames (plus 1 pre-existing grid) in manifest.json; images were not baked (--skip-images). Two tooling defects found: (a) the help documents --out DIR but the parser (tools/track/build-gallery.cjs:644) only accepts --out=DIR, so the space form silently rewrites the tracked gallery/tracks/ (I reverted that with git checkout); (b) WEATHER_TAIL (:42) lacks storm, so day-storm frames get tod: unknown and drop out of the time-of-day filter. Also gh GraphQL is 403 in this container, so 0 survey branches were scanned.
  • Estimates not measured: Pagoda height, bay capacities, shed counts (see the brief's UNCERTAIN list).
